messages:
Alex: Heads-up — Lantern wants a 2-week smoke POC to swap from CompetitorX -> Redwood. Need to align on network egress, short-term pricing, and response shape deltas.
Maria: What are the buyer "asks" specifically?
Alex: Parity for the chat + embeddings endpoints, sameish latency SLA for the POC, and completion of their security questionnaire. Ballpark usage during POC ~5M tokens/mo.
Maria: Got it. We can do trial credits + a temporary committed discount. @Sanjeev can you own the adapter checklist?
Sanjeev: On it. Quick triage: CompetitorX returns responses under choices[].message.content; we return an "output" array. Adapter just needs to remap and preserve ids. Also our tokenizer token counts differ ~5-8% which affects billing delta.
Sanjeev: Minimal mapping snippet I’ll use in the smoke adapter:
```json
{
  "choices": [{"message": {"content": "<text>"}}]
}
->
{
  "output": "<text>"
}
```
Emily: On pricing — for a 2-week POC we usually offer $X in credits + a 30% pilot discount if they commit to a small reserved amount after the POC. Need Finance ok.
Maria: I'll confirm numbers with Finance. Legal also flagged data residency — Lantern requires EU-only for the POC. Ops: can we run eu-west-1 hosted env?
Emily: Yes, we can spin a hosted-region POC in eu-west-1. For networking they want whitelisted egress IPs, production will require VPC. For now we provide a small CIDR list and a DNS endpoint.
SecBot: Security questionnaire submitted to the customer portal: https://redwood.internal/sec/lantern/quest-2147 — SOC2 artifacts and encryption details attached.
Sanjeev: A few functional caveats to call out for the customer:
- Streaming semantics: CompetitorX sends chunk deltas with incremental "patch" ids; Redwood streams SSE with event types. Adapter will translate event frames to expected patch deltas.
- Stop sequences: we trim trailing tokens earlier than CompetitorX in some cases; tests show differences on trailing punctuation.
- Model parity: pin to open-3b-v1 for the POC — metrics show similar BLEU/ROUGE on their eval set, but hallucination rates differ on a small subset.
Alex: Good. Who owns the smoke test harness and client-side adapter?
Sanjeev: I'll ship a minimal Node script + tests by Tue. It will: remap response shape, normalize streaming events, and include token delta logging.
Maria: I'll draft the pilot SOW + pricing and send to Lantern legal by EOD Wed.
Emily: I'll produce the ops runbook + IP/CIDR list and share the region deployment steps.
SecBot: Noted — questionnaire flow will send reminder if Lantern doesn't ack in 48h.
Alex: Next sync Tue 10am PT. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
